messages:
Ashwin (infra): Heads up — spike in inference tail latency starting ~06:07 UTC in us-central1. 99th went from ~120ms -> ~520ms, several Pods restarted. /cc @Sara
ops-bot: Alert: Preemptible instance termination rate increased in project-redwood-serving-us-central1 — 18 terminations in 5m
Sara (oncall): Looking now. Which pools are impacted?
Ashwin (infra): Mixed pool `gpu-mix-v2` — preemptible fraction got hammered, on-demand capacity couldn't absorb. KV cache hit-rate fell ~35% -> lots of re-generations.
Kevin (eng-sre): Seeing queue buildup on rollout-workers. Logs show repeated `KVCacheMiss` + gRPC timeouts to the model-backend.
Rajiv (scheduling): Provider posted maintenance in us-central1-c, looks correlated. Any quick mitigations we can flip?
Mira (product): This is hitting latency-sensitive paths. Should we failover those routes to dedicated capacity while we stabilize?
Ashwin (infra): Proposed short-term plan: 1) enable route fallback for `prod-latency` to dedicated pool (canary) 2) temporarily spin up on-demand burst in us-east1 to absorb load 3) reprovision a subset of preemptibles to rebalance (avoid hot-evict shard)
Sara (oncall): I can enable fallback now. Kevin — can you start the burst pool? We accept short-term cost hit.
Kevin (eng-sre): Kicking off on-demand spin-up. Quick check command I ran: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep preemptible` showed many preemptible nodes in NotReady/Terminating state. Starting 12 on-demand GPUs in us-east1, ETA ~5m.
ops-bot: Action logged — route fallback enabled for `prod-latency` at 06:13 UTC by Sara (oncall)
Ashwin (infra): After enabling fallback + extra on-demand, 99th latency dropped to ~180ms and queue depth reduced. Cache warmup still ongoing, expect further improvements in 10-15m.
Rajiv (scheduling): For longer term: reduce preemptible ratio for `gpu-mix-v2` for KV-heavy routes, and make autoscaler prefer on-demand for groups with persistent cache state.
Mira (product): Please capture affected tenants and timeline — we'll need a short comms summary. Also add cost delta for the burst.
Kevin (eng-sre): Agreed. Action items: 1) add alert `preemptible termination rate > 5 / min for 3m` 2) run a cost projection for 12 on-demand GPUs for 1 hour 3) update autoscaler policy draft.
Sara (oncall): Monitoring for 30m. If stable we'll roll the fallback back and re-evaluate pool mix. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Ashwin (infra): Follow-up owners: Rajiv (pool config change), Kevin (alerts + cost), Mira (customer comms). I'll start a postmortem draft and include metric graphs.
Mira (product): Put the postmortem on the backlog with priority P2 and tag the affected customers.
Kevin (eng-sre): Also worth investigating whether prefix/KV cache eviction under churn caused unnecessary regeneration — might be a cache warm-preserve fix.
Sara (oncall): Noted. Closing loop when postmortem and cost numbers are in. :lock:
